reviews.author: Nico
reviews.quote: No where else in Palm Beach County can you get a hand wash as fast and as well compared to Hector's. The real treat is all the cars that roll by — Bentleys, Aston Martins, Mercedes galore. Come to Hector's and get the VIP treatment for fair prices.

reviews.author: Riley Ziegler
reviews.quote: This is my family's absolute favorite car wash. There's no one we trust more with our vehicles than Hector and his team. They never fail to leave our car sparkling. They're very mindful of not leaving dents or scrapes, too.

reviews.author: Christopher Schalk
reviews.quote: I travel out of my way passing at least 8 car washes just to come to Hector's. They always do a great job with my oversized truck. They are quick and efficient. I wouldn't go anywhere else.

reviews.author: Peter Flavor
reviews.quote: Hector's is great. They wash the inside and outside of your car for a very reasonable price and you can even add on the Rain-X if you'd like. Very time efficient and multiple hard workers on your car at all times. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jayden Anthony
reviews.quote: They did a great job and I'm so pleased with the results. The finish on my car is awesome, and it even looks better than the day I bought it. Thanks Hector for taking care of my vehicle and making me happy on the road.
